listing.name: Common Drops 1.1 - Cherry picking blueprints made easy
listing.summary: This is a simple mod that adds individual blueprints for all ships, weapons and fighters that are part of a blueprint package but don't have their own rare drop. Unlike the rare drops, however, these are much easier to acquire.
listing.aiSummary: Adds individual blueprints for ships, weapons, and fighters found in blueprint packages but lacking rare drops.

description:
This is a simple mod that adds individual blueprints for all ships, weapons and fighters that are part of a blueprint package but don't have their own rare drop. Unlike the rare drops, however, these are much easier to acquire.
For when you really want your faction to only use specific ships, look to Common Drops.

Changelog:
1.1 - Decreased price of common blueprints.
